lines.3: 「What's up, Crab? The pain go away?」
lines.4: 「Yeah. If anything, I feel better than before.」
lines.5: 「Which means it's time to go beat that Black Bean into the ground.」
lines.6: 「Black Bean? You mean Otome? Are you really going through with your revenge?」
lines.7: 「Of course. You always pay someone back threefold.」
lines.8: 「I mean, she made you cry the first time you met. No wonder you're mad.」
lines.10: 「Come on, Leo, don't pick on Crabby again.」
lines.11: 「Listen, Yoppi. At the school gate today... (abridged) ...and that's what happened.」
lines.12: 「The part where she lost an epic five-minute battle is a complete lie, but the rest is mostly accurate.」
lines.13: 「So I'm planning to take retaliatory measures.」
lines.14: 「D-don't do it, Crabby! Taking revenge on Otome... You've heard people call her the Iron Disciplinarian, haven't you? She doesn't show mercy.」
lines.15: Thank you for worrying about this idiot's life.
lines.16: 「Apparently, the other third-years call her that and live in fear of her. No wonder I thought they all seemed weirdly subdued.」
lines.17: 「Well, I'll turn that uptight Iron Disciplinarian into scrap metal.」
lines.18: 「That is exactly what someone says right before getting demolished.」
lines.19: 「Otome won a national martial arts tournament or something. She's incredibly strong.」
lines.21: 「How are you planning to get revenge on someone that strong?」
lines.22: 「Don't be stupid. I don't have to fight fair. I can use my head.」
lines.23: 「There are plenty of options. I could hurt the people around her and make her suffer emotionally.」
lines.25: 「You'll help me, obviously. We're friends, aren't we?」
lines.26: 「No. Because I have a bad feeling about this.」
lines.27: 「Man, this guy's useless. Fine, Fukahire will do.」
lines.28: 「Huh, me? No way. I hate that prickly type. She reminds me of my sister, and it's terrifying.」
lines.29: 「That's exactly why you need to conquer your fear, isn't it? Are you really okay with staying beaten?」
lines.30: 「...Y-you're right. That would go against my creed.」
lines.31: 「What is it you're always saying, Fukahire?」
lines.32: 「Girls must devote themselves to men! That has been an ironclad rule since ancient times!」
lines.33: 「Any woman who gets the wrong idea needs to be taught a lesson!」
lines.34: 「Ooh, pour on the fuel! Now you're fired up. That's some impressive hatred of women.」
